component.name: Simple Cuts
component.summary: Trim camera footage and strip audio before editing

description.p: Open your camera clips, mark the parts you want to keep and export them, optionally without audio, ready to import into your video editor.

ul.li: Lossless stream-copy export, or frame-accurate re-encoding (NVIDIA GPU or CPU)
Any number of segments per clip, optionally joined into one file
Batch export of a whole camera card
Follows your GTK theme and dark/light preference
